Our Story

We're Austin and Jessica, your ranchers from Texas! Our family has been raising cattle for several generations and we are honored to provide your family with high quality beef. We feel a strong conviction to regenerate the land in order to improve the health of the soil, therefore increasing the nutrient profile of the plants and animals. We utilize regenerative practices, rotational grazing, and low stress cattle handling. It is our goal to bring health to our animals, our land, our family, and yours!

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What is regenerative ranching?

Regenerative ranching is more than just raising cattle—it’s a holistic approach to land stewardship that works with nature to restore soil health, improve biodiversity, and create a self-sustaining ecosystem.

By using rotational grazing, our cattle naturally fertilize the land, aerate the soil with their hooves, and help sequester carbon—revitalizing the earth rather than depleting it. Unlike conventional methods, we never rely on synthetic fertilizers, pesticides, or grain-based feeds. Instead, our livestock thrive on nutrient-rich, diverse pastures, just as nature intended.

Why It Matters:

✔ Healthier Soil – Builds organic matter, retains water, and prevents erosion

✔ Happier, Healthier Animals – Raised in open spaces with their natural diet

✔ Nutrient-Dense Meat – Higher in Omega-3s, CLAs, and essential vitamins

✔ Better for the Planet – Captures carbon, supports pollinators, and regenerates ecosystems

Regenerative ranching is imperative as it ensures healthy land, healthy animals, and healthier food for generations to come.

MEET YOUR RANCHERS
We are Austin and Jessica and we are glad you're here! We both come from ranching families and can't imagine doing life anywhere else than here on the ranch in West Texas. There are many generations of ranchers on each side of our families and we are raising the next generation to love and care for the land and animals too. 
​Our family is excited to offer quality beef from our ranch to your table. It is our HONOR to be a part of the meals you serve with those you love most and be a small part of memories that will last a lifetime!
OUR PRACTICES
Regenerative | Rotational Grazing | Grass-Fed & Finished | No Grains | No Till | No Hormones | No Antibiotics | Non-GMO
WHERE IT ALL STARTED

Austin's grandfather adopted the holistic management principals in 1987 which were championed by Allan Savory. We are the fifth generation of ranchers and have chosen to continue and add on to those holistic principles.

We have raised cattle for many years, but Canyon Valley Provisions was created in 2019.

 Holistic management of a cowherd encompasses many things. Our animals are kept in one herd and are always on the move across the ranch. This provides the rangeland with several key needs; trampling of old growth, aeration of the soil, and ample time for plants to recover. We move our cattle horseback and still feel that this is the most effective way to get things done.

​"Grass fed" and "grass finished" are common terms but we prefer to call our beef “wild crafted” because there is more to the animals’ diet than just grass. Yes, our cattle are grass fed and grass finished, but that is only a part of the picture.

​We are blessed to have native rangeland so our animals have access to a diverse salad bar of grasses, forbs, legumes, and woody plants to eat. The flavor and nutrients of our beef is found in that amazing diversity! Our management style also ensures that every piece of meat is completely absent of any grains, added hormones, antibiotics herbicides, or pesticides.

​It is our goal to bring health to our animals, our land, our family, and yours.
